name: fix85_arena_spectators
verifies: fix-85 item 2: bystanders of an arena fight watch as spectators (G3 ZS_WatchFight -> ZS_WatchFight_Spectator: a free Spectator point, none at the CP arenas, else where they stand, only turning to the fighters) instead of keeping 5.5-6.5 m from the fighters (ZS_WatchFight_Loop), so nobody walks into the Reddock ring
notes: watchspec counts the spectators (informational: depends on who is near the ring at noon); watchloop must stay 0 for an arena fight; watchinring counts watchers inside the arena zone (the fighters are not watchers). Same rule for Montera/Nordmar arenas.
